name: Humanitaria (Humanitarian Protection for Vulnerable Persons)

qualifying_event.description: A person in a recognized situation of vulnerability -- an asylum/refugee applicant, a trafficking victim, an unaccompanied minor, a stateless person, or a person displaced by a natural disaster -- may be granted Humanitaria status, issued by Peru's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (RREE).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documentation of the qualifying vulnerability condition (varies by category, e.g. trafficking-victim identification, statelessness determination, disaster-displacement record).

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must fall within a recognized vulnerable category: asylum/refugee applicant, victim of trafficking, unaccompanied minor, stateless person, or person displaced by a natural disaster.

evidence_required.document: Documentation of the qualifying vulnerability condition

outcome.duration_length: up to 183 days, extendable for as long as the vulnerability condition persists

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.k: Humanitaria resident status, issued by RREE, up to 183 days extendable while vulnerability conditions persist, various forms of employment permitted
